verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-API SaaS, so the axis applies. Yet every piece of evidence describes AgentMail as a hosted service: a hosted API, a hosted MCP endpoint and API keys issued by AgentMail. The only self-hosting mention is a third-party project (autopilot) pitched as a self-hosted replacement for AgentMail, which suggests AgentMail itself cannot be self-hosted.
